title: eng-runtime
text:
eng-runtime

alex: Quick sanity check — onboarding 'aurora-70b-mqa' model. weights in s3://redwood-models/aurora/70b/mqa/v2/ but tokenization tests are failing (we see OOV BPE merges). Also unit tests show RoPE scale mismatch in attn outputs vs reference. Can someone eyeball config + tokenizer? @priya @josh :eyes:

priya: looking. What exact tokenizer file did you use? HF fast vs legacy matters for merges.

alex: using tokenizer.json from the weights folder. sample error: 'unknown token: ģ' in eval logs.

josh: pinging infra — can you confirm the weights manifest and sha?

mina: s3 path exists, manifest.json present, sha256: abcdef1234567890deadbeef. owner=eng-runtime. Model ingest job recently failed once (job id 4821) due to mmap limit.

deploy-bot: model-ingest 4821 failed: mmap(2) ENOMEM during shard load — retry scheduled.

alex: repro command i ran:
```
PYTHONPATH=. ./scripts/serve_local.py --model s3://redwood-models/aurora/70b/mqa/v2 --max-seq 2048 --gqa True
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "serve_local.py", line 88, in <module>
    load_weights(...)
RuntimeError: RoPE scale mismatch: expected 1.0, got 1.125
```

priya: that suggests config quantiles or rotary scaling param mismatch. Check model config: rotary_scale in config.json is 1.125 but runtime default is 1.0. We added automatic scaling for GQA/MQA tests — runtime needs runtime param `--rotary-scale 1.125` or we should patch config to 1.0 for compatibility. Prefer adding compat path in runtime.

josh: also check attention impl flag `--use-mqa` vs `--mqa-mode gqa`. We have two knobs historically. If both set inconsistently you get index errors.

alex: I pushed a small PR that adds a more helpful error and fallback: #1042

chris: @alex nice. For short-term, run with `--rotary-compat` which forces legacy scaling. Also set `--sliding-window off` for the test to avoid kv-cache misalignment.

priya: quick config snippet to try:
```
"runtime": {
  "rotary_scale": 1.125,
  "mqa_mode": "gqa",
  "sliding_window": 2048,
  "tokenizer_type": "hf-fast"
}
```

josh: verified manifest sha matches, mina confirmed bucket permissions fine.

alex: ack. I'll try runtime flags and update PR. Can someone review PR when it's up? tag @priya @chris

priya: will review later today. :thumbsup:

chris: leaving a small note in the PR about adding an integration test for RoPE scaling edgecases.

alex: thanks all — will update thread with test results.
